snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.description: Cold filesystem checkpoints include ignored and generated files. Stop active agent turns before creating one. Running processes are not saved.
snapshots.exclusions: Optional exclusions (one workspace-relative path per line)
snapshots.restoreWarning: Restore replaces the selected archived workspace. Use Fork to keep its current contents.
snapshots.deleteConfirm: Delete this snapshot? Its checkpoint and image are reclaimed when no runtime still references them.

errors.busy: The workspace is busy. Stop active agent turns and retry.
errors.budget: The sandbox snapshot budget is exhausted. Delete unneeded snapshots or increase sandboxSnapshotBudgetBytes.
errors.action: The Host could not complete the snapshot operation. Refresh and retry.

previews.title: Preview links
previews.description: Links serve this machine only. Copy once and redeem within 60 seconds; each copied link can be redeemed only once. Access expires automatically and can be revoked.

errors.action: The Host could not complete the preview operation. Refresh and retry.
errors.browser: The embedded browser is unavailable on this screen. Open a workspace browser pane and retry.
errors.clipboard: Could not copy the link, or its 60-second redemption window expired. Create a new link.

previews.originHelp: Numeric loopback fallback is disabled because cookies are shared across ports. If this browser cannot resolve the isolated localhost address, preview access is unavailable.
